title: Fraction of a Number

blocks.html: You can multiply a fraction by a whole number, and you know a fraction is a division. Now find a fraction of a number, like $\frac{2}{3}$ of 12.

To find $\frac{a}{b}$ of a number, divide it into $b$ equal parts and take $a$ of them. $\frac{2}{3}$ of 12 is 2 groups of $\frac{1}{3}$ of 12: $2 \times 4 = 8$. This is the same as $\frac{2}{3} \times 12$.

$\frac{1}{3}$ of 12 means 12 split into 3 equal parts: $12 \div 3 = 4$. Two of those parts are $2 \times 4 = 8$. Multiplying first works too: $\frac{2 \times 12}{3} = \frac{24}{3} = 8$, because 2 copies of 12 split into 3 parts gives the same amount.

blocks.title: A story
blocks.q: A class has 30 students. $\frac{3}{5}$ of them ride the bus. How many ride the bus?

blocks.html: Dividing by the numerator instead of the denominator, like finding $\frac{2}{3}$ of 12 as $12 \div 2 = 6$. The denominator says how many equal parts to make. Check: $\frac{2}{3}$ is more than half, so the answer must be more than 6.
